name: @visuelconcept/wui-gis-plants
description: Power plants — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page: the operating parameters of every plant driven by the GIS network simulator (GisSim_<assetId>_<element>: output, capacity, load factor, voltage, frequency, state), one card per plant, ranked live by output and re-ranked on every change. Read-only; alarms are not shown in this first version.

datapoints.note: Reads only. The datapoints are created and driven by the optional gisSim manager of @visuelconcept/wui-gis; without it the page shows an empty state.
